errors.DRIVE_INVALID_FOLDER_URL: That link doesn't look like a Google Drive folder. Copy it from “Share” → “Copy link” with the folder open.
errors.DRIVE_FOLDER_NOT_SHARED: We can't see the folder yet. Check that you shared it with the CEITBA account as Viewer and try again in a minute.
errors.DRIVE_FOLDER_NOT_OWNED: That folder isn't yours. You can only connect folders you own in Drive.
errors.DRIVE_SYNC_RATE_LIMITED: You requested a sync recently. You can request another one in a few minutes (at most one every 5 minutes).
errors.DRIVE_SYNC_UNCONFIGURED: Notes isn't available yet: the Google Drive connection hasn't been configured.

picker.noMatches: No subjects match that name or code.
picker.typeToSearch: Type to search for a subject.

tree.intro: Pick the subject of each folder or file: whatever you set on a folder is inherited by its files. Only files with a subject that you don't hide get published.
tree.empty: No files yet. If you just connected the folder, the first sync can take a few minutes.
tree.notMineHint: Someone else created it: CEITBA reviews it before publishing.
tree.recomputeHint: Suggests subjects again using your current plan (e.g. after changing your career or plan in your profile).
tree.foreignHint: Other people's files stay hidden until you publish them; CEITBA reviews them before they're shown.

wizard.title: Connect a Drive folder
wizard.step1Intro: For CEITBA to read your notes, share the folder with our account. It only reads: it never edits or deletes anything in your Drive.
wizard.step1Open: In Google Drive, right-click the folder → “Share”.
wizard.warningTitle: Drive will show you a warning, and that's expected
wizard.warningBody: Since the CEITBA account isn't an @itba.edu.ar one, Drive warns that you're sharing “outside your organization”. That's normal: confirm with “Share anyway”.
wizard.step1Scope: Tip: share just your notes folder, not your whole Drive. You can disconnect it anytime.
wizard.folderUrlHint: In Drive: “Share” → “Copy link”, with the folder open.
wizard.folderUrlWarn: That doesn't look like a Drive folder link (it should contain “/folders/”). You can still try.
wizard.anonymousHint: Your notes show up as from “A student”. CEITBA still knows who shared them. You can change it later.
wizard.consentAccept: I've read and accept the terms for sharing my notes.

report.title: Report file
report.intro: Tell us what's wrong with “{{name}}”. After several reports the file is hidden until CEITBA reviews it.
report.commentPlaceholder: Any detail that helps us review it.
report.thanks: Thanks, we got your report. CEITBA will review it.

home.title: Notes
home.subtitle: Summaries, guides and past exams ITBA students share from their Google Drive, organized by subject.
home.ctaBody: Connect a folder from your Drive and help the students who come after you. It updates itself when you edit.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search a subject by name or code (e.g. 72.08)
home.noMatchesHint: Try another name or the subject code.
home.emptyBody: Be the first to share yours.
home.mineNoPlan: Pick your career and plan to see your subjects here.

subject.emptyTitle: No notes for this subject yet
subject.emptyBody: If you have notes for this subject in your Drive, connect the folder and assign it the subject.
subject.notFoundBody: The code may be wrong or the subject may no longer exist.

file.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, hidden or unpublished.

mine.title: My notes
mine.subtitle: The Drive folders you shared with CEITBA. Assign subjects, hide what you don't want published and sync whenever you want.
mine.connected: We connected “{{name}}”. The first sync can take a few minutes.
mine.syncQueued: We requested a sync of “{{name}}”. Changes show up in a few minutes.
mine.disconnected: You disconnected “{{name}}”. Its files are no longer shown.
mine.emptyTitle: You haven't connected any folder yet
mine.emptyBody: Share a folder from your Drive with CEITBA and your notes will show up here so you can assign them subjects.

statusHint.PENDING_REVIEW: CEITBA is reviewing your folder. Meanwhile you can assign subjects: they're published once it's approved.
statusHint.BLOCKED: CEITBA blocked this folder and its files aren't shown. Write to ceitba@itba.edu.ar if you think it's a mistake.
statusHint.REVOKED: We no longer have access to the folder. Share it again with the CEITBA account to keep syncing.
statusHint.ERROR: The last sync failed. Try “Sync now” in a few minutes.

mine.sourceMissing: We couldn't find that folder among yours.
mine.disconnectBody: “{{name}}” stops syncing and its notes are no longer shown on the site. Your Drive isn't touched. To fully stop CEITBA from seeing it, stop sharing it in Drive.

viewer.sheetTruncated: Showing the first {{rows}} rows and {{cols}} columns. Download the file to see all of it.
viewer.textTruncated: The file is very long: only the beginning is shown. Download it to see all of it.

card.unsupported: This kind of file can't be viewed in the browser. Download it to open it.
card.tooLarge: It's too large to preview (over 15 MB). Download it to open it.
card.failed: We couldn't show the preview. Download it to open it.
card.noContent: We don't have a copy of this file yet. It may be too large or still syncing.
card.blocked: The author disabled downloads for this file. You can view it in Google Drive.

pins.title: Pinned
pins.hint: Pin subjects with the pin button to keep them handy here.
pins.limit: You've reached the maximum of {{limit}} pinned subjects. Unpin one to add another.
pins.failed: We couldn't update your pinned subjects. Please try again.

source.USER: Set by whoever shared the notes
source.NAME: Detected in the file name
source.DRIVE: Estimated from the file's date in Drive

wiki.graphHint: This subject's pages and the pages of other subjects they link with. Tap a node to open it.
wiki.aiLabel: AI-generated from student notes · may contain errors
wiki.reportIntro: Tell us what's wrong with “{{title}}”. CEITBA reviews reports and fixes or hides the page.
wiki.emptyTitle: No wiki for this subject yet
wiki.emptyBody: The wiki is built from published notes. Meanwhile, have a look at the files.
wiki.notFoundBody: It may have been renamed, hidden or not exist yet.

cite.report: Report an error in this part

graphUi.canvasAria: Graph: drag to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom; keys + − 0 and arrows
graphUi.keysHint: + − zoom · 0 fit · arrows pan · Esc clear

map.title: Notes map
map.subtitle: Every subject wiki in one map, grouped by subject. Bolder lines connect different subjects.
map.open: See the map of all subjects
map.emptyMine: No wikis for your subjects yet
map.emptyMineBody: Pin subjects or set your plan in your profile; you can also view the full map.

years.stale: These notes are more than 3 years old; the subject's syllabus may have changed.

drive.intro: Moderate the notes students share from Google Drive: approve new folders, review files that need a decision and see what was shared with the CEITBA account without being connected.
drive.conflict: The status changed while you were looking (another staff member or a sync). We reloaded the list.

sources.approvedNotice: You approved “{{name}}”. Its files with a subject are published on the next sync.
sources.blockedNotice: You blocked “{{name}}”. Its files are no longer visible.
sources.blockBody: “{{name}}” ({{owner}}) stops syncing and its files are hidden. You can approve it again later.

files.ownerDiffers: The file's owner isn't the person who shared it.
files.removeNotice: You removed “{{name}}”. It won't be republished by later syncs.
files.removeBody: “{{name}}” is hidden from everyone and stays hidden across syncs. You can restore it later.

unclaimed.intro: Folders someone shared with the CEITBA account but nobody connected from “My notes”. If they linger, consider reaching out to whoever shared them.

wiki.hideBody: “{{title}}” disappears from the wiki until you restore it.

devLogin.title: Dev login
devLogin.body: Signs in through POST /v1/auth/dev-login (API with the dev profile and AUTH_DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true). It doesn't exist in production.
devLogin.name: Name
